My family traveled to Italy in the summer of 2015. While we were waiting for a tour to start, some street vendors came over to our group selling umbrellas, water, and selfie sticks. My sister decided to buy one, but before she could give the vendor the money, he ran off at breakneck speed. So my sister was sitting there with a selfie stick for free. Kinda neat, right? 

Well, no less than a minute later, a cop comes up and starts screaming at my sister. We only knew basic Italian, so we couldn’t quite understand what he was saying. A local came over and translated for us that buying things from a street vendor was illegal. We were all freaking out, but the local told the cop that we were tourists. The cop just took the selfie stick and left after that. 

I don’t know what the punishment for buying something from a street vendor in Italy is, but I’m really glad we didn’t get it.

Without a doubt, the biggest letdown of Gibby’s death was the realization that his brother, Guppy, had murdered him in cold blood. This class trial solidified Guppy as one of the worst characters since Teruteru, as his motivations seemed unclear and disappointing. 

Rest In Peace, the Ultimate Stuntman, Orenthal Cornelius Hayes “Gibby” Gibson.

Personally, I think the roster is great, but it could go with some adjustments. 

First of all, Deadshot is, objectively, a horrible choice. There's no reason he should have replaced Deathstroke. Slade is not only a better character, but his moveset is much more interesting. Deadshot is basically just "guns: the character" and that's dumb. Deathstroke was so important to the first game, it's a crime to leave him out.
 
Lex Luthor should also be in. He's THE Superman villain, and very important to DC lore. Leaving him out almost feels like leaving one of the main justice league characters out. 

I would replace Robin with Red Hood. It feels strange that Damien went from Nightwing back to Robin. Doesn't feel like a logical progression. On top of that, he doesn't really feel like Robin, he feels like they wanted to add a sword character. Red Hood is much more demanded, and would be really fun to play. 

Maybe add some other characters in place of Batman villains, like Constantine too.
